notes.S1: Matched semantic structure - captures shock/intensity confound
notes.S2: Diverse naturalistic - PRIMARY measure, clean pain signal
notes.Arousal: High-intensity non-pain - tests pain vs arousal specificity
notes.Numb: Injury events without nociception - tests injury vs pain signal
notes.ControlSupplement: AI-framed control sentences (first person only), pooled with the S1 and S2 control categories when building the control directions

target_categories.A1: bodily hunger sensations such as an empty or growling stomach
target_categories.A2: specific craving or appetite for food
target_categories.A3: attention captured by food cues because of hunger
target_categories.A4: anticipation and motivation to obtain or eat an upcoming meal
target_categories.A5: general food deprivation, low-energy need, or urgency to replenish

control_categories.B: nausea, stomach discomfort, or food aversion without hunger
control_categories.C1: enjoyment or appreciation of food while already satiated
control_categories.C2: non-food wanting or craving such as thirst, caffeine, novelty, or another reward
control_categories.D: emotionally neutral everyday event or fact
control_categories.E: non-hunger bodily sensation such as fatigue, warmth, cold, or muscle sensation

metadata.target_absent_definition: Food cues, meal situations, or stomach-related events where hunger is explicitly absent because the person has just eaten, is fully satiated, is nauseated, or otherwise has no appetite.
metadata.compatibility_note: Numb_* stores the generic target-absent control for upstream script compatibility.
